title: Rethinking Fixed Temporal Grids: Frequency-Disentangled Motion Generation
title_zh: 重新思考固定时间网格：频率解耦的运动生成

paragraphs.en: Most human motion generation methods encode motion as tokens on a uniform temporal grid, where every token spans the same fixed time window. Human motion, however, is temporally heterogeneous: slowly evolving global trajectories coexist with rapid transient events such as foot contacts and joint impulses. Forcing such multi-scale dynamics onto tokens of identical temporal resolution entangles motion frequencies, leaving slow regions redundant while smoothing out the rapid details that distinguish realistic motion. We propose FreqMo , a scale-adaptive motion representation that decomposes motion into wavelet frequency bands, separating dynamics across temporal scales while preserving temporal localization and exact reconstruction. Unified Frequency Residual Quantization (UFRQ) then encodes all bands within a single shared codebook, compressing the token sequence threefold and enabling stable single-stage generation. Experiments show FreqMo attains SOTA fidelity with substantially improved high-frequency preservation, and the same decomposition transfers to continuous diffusion backbones.

paragraphs.en: Realistic human motion generation ( Khani et al. 2025 ; Xiao et al. 2025 ) underpins virtual reality ( Burdea and Coiffet 2003 ) , embodied intelligence ( Duan et al. 2022 ) , and digital human synthesis ( Varol et al. 2017 ) . Following language and vision ( Achiam et al. 2023 ; Peebles and Xie 2023 ) , prevailing methods encode motion on a fixed temporal grid where every token spans identical temporal support ( Cho et al. 2025 ; Dai et al. 2024 ; Lu et al. 2025 ) . This mirrors words in text or patches in images, where semantics reside within individual units and uniform discretization is well justified. Human motion, by contrast, is a continuous, non-stationary process whose semantics arise not from isolated poses but from temporally extended interactions: the evolution of a stride, the impulse of a landing, the deceleration into rest. Despite this distinction, few works question whether a fixed grid inherited from other modalities suits the dynamic nature of human motion (Figure 1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 真实的人类动作生成（Khani 等人，2025；Xiao 等人，2025）是虚拟现实（Burdea 和 Coiffet，2003）、具身智能（Duan 等人，2022）以及数字人类合成（Varol 等人，2017）的基础。 继语言与视觉之后（Achiam 等人，2023；Peebles 和 Xie，2023），主流方法将动作编码在固定的时间网格上，其中每个标记都覆盖相同的时间跨度（Cho 等人，2025；Dai 等人，2024；Lu 等人，2025）。 这与文本中的词语或图像中的图像块类似：语义存在于单个单元内部，因此均匀的离散化是合理的。 相比之下，人类动作是一个连续且非平稳的过程，其语义并非来自孤立的姿态，而是源于时间上延续的互动：步态的演变、着陆时的冲力，以及减速至静止的过程。 尽管存在这种差异，但很少有研究质疑从其他模态继承而来的固定网格是否适合人类动作的动态特性（图1）。

paragraphs.en: This oversight has concrete representational consequences. The inter-frame dynamics that define motion semantics are temporally heterogeneous, spanning orders of magnitude from slowly evolving global trajectories to near-instantaneous events such as foot contacts and joint impulses. A common practice augments each token with temporal derivatives (velocity, acceleration) ( Guo et al. 2022a ) , yet this captures higher-order statistics of the same entangled mixture rather than disentangling its frequency components. Since dynamics at distinct temporal scales correspond to distinct spectral frequencies, projecting them onto identically supported tokens forces these components to mix inseparably, leading to frequency entanglement (Figure 7 ) ( Yuan et al. 2024 ; Fu 2024 ) . Tokens spanning slow dynamics carry redundant information, while those spanning rapid transients smooth out the details they should preserve. This distortion originates at the representation level: a structural consequence of single-resolution indexing that no per-token enrichment can resolve, not a capacity deficit.
paragraphs.zh: 这种疏漏会产生具体的表示层面影响。 定义运动语义的帧间动态在时间上具有异质性，其时间跨度跨越多个数量级，从缓慢演化的全局轨迹到近乎瞬时的事件（如足部接触和关节冲击）。 一种常见做法是为每个词元添加时间导数（速度、加速度）（Guo et al. 2022a），但这实际上捕捉的是同一纠缠混合体的高阶统计特征，而非将其频率成分解耦。 由于不同时间尺度上的动态对应不同的频谱频率，将它们投影到具有相同支撑集的词元上，会迫使这些成分不可分割地混合在一起，从而导致频率纠缠（图7）（Yuan et al. 2024；Fu 2024）。 覆盖缓慢动态的词元携带冗余信息，而覆盖快速瞬态变化的词元则会平滑掉本应保留的细节。 这种失真源于表示层面：它是单一分辨率索引所导致的结构性后果，任何词元级的增强都无法解决，而非容量不足所致。

paragraphs.en: Disentangling these frequencies is not as simple as transforming motion into the frequency domain. First, decomposing motion by frequency alone, as a global spectral transform does ( Fourier 1822 ) , records which frequencies occur but not when, untenable for motion, whose semantics are defined by precisely when events happen. A natural remedy reintroduces time through local windows ( Allen and Rabiner 1977 ) , but at a fixed scale: one window resolves all frequencies alike, too coarse for fast transients and too fine for slow trends. What motion needs is thus resolution that adapts to frequency, together with temporal localization. On this basis, we adopt the Wavelet Transform ( Mallat 1999 ) , whose variable-resolution filtering gives broad context to low-frequency trajectories and fine precision to high-frequency transients while preserving temporal resolution. This makes frequency disentanglement a property of the representation rather than the architecture.
paragraphs.zh: 将这些频率分离出来，并不像将运动转换到频域那样简单。 首先，仅通过频率对运动进行分解（如全局谱变换所做的那样（Fourier 1822）），虽然能记录哪些频率出现，却无法记录它们出现的时间；而运动的语义正是由事件发生的确切时间所定义的，因此这种方法是不可行的。 一种自然的解决方案是通过局部窗口重新引入时间因素（Allen and Rabiner 1977），但这一方法采用固定尺度：单个窗口对所有频率的解析效果相同，对于快速瞬态信号而言过于粗糙，而对于缓慢趋势而言又过于精细。 因此，运动需要能够根据频率自适应的分辨率，同时还要具备时间上的局部化能力。 基于此，我们采用了小波变换（Mallat 1999），其可变分辨率的滤波机制既能为低频轨迹提供宽泛的上下文信息，又能为高频瞬态信号带来精细的精度，同时保留了时间分辨率。 这使得频率分离成为表示方法本身的特性，而非架构的特性。

paragraphs.en: However, directly quantizing multi-scale wavelet features inevitably introduces quantization error. A residual scheme mitigates this, encoding each band against the reconstruction of the earlier ones. The order of this refinement, however, is decisive: the wavelet hierarchy runs from high-frequency detail to coarse global structure, so refining in that order would fix transient details before the low-frequency structure that anchors the motion. We instead encode coarse to fine, locking the global structure first so that residual error is confined to the high-frequency detail where it least matters.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，直接对多尺度小波特征进行量化不可避免地会引入量化误差。 一种残差方案可以缓解这一问题，即每个频段都相对于前一个频段的重建结果进行编码。 不过，这种精细化的顺序至关重要：小波层级从高频细节到粗略的全局结构依次排列，因此按照这一顺序进行精细化，会在固定运动所依赖的低频结构之前，先修正瞬态细节。 我们转而采用从粗略到精细的编码方式，首先锁定全局结构，这样残差误差就被限制在影响最小的部分——即高频细节中。

paragraphs.en: Building upon this, we present FreqMo , a scale-adaptive motion generation framework. FreqMo decomposes motion latents into hierarchical frequency bands via multi-level wavelet transform, aligning the representation with the intrinsic temporal scale of each dynamic component. To instantiate this in discrete generative models, we propose Unified Frequency Residual Quantization (UFRQ), which encodes all frequency bands into a single shared codebook through coarse-to-fine residual refinement, replacing fragmented multi-codebook pipelines and cutting the token sequence to one third of comparable designs. A scale-aware masked transformer ( Chang et al. 2022 ) then generates all bands simultaneously for stable single-stage generation. The decomposition is moreover agnostic to the generator: transplanting it into a continuous diffusion pipeline improves that model as well, showing the gain lies in the representation rather than any particular quantization scheme.
paragraphs.zh: 在此基础上，我们提出了 FreqMo——一个能够自适应尺度的运动生成框架。 FreqMo 通过多级小波变换将运动潜在表示分解为分层频率带，使该表示与每个动态组件的内在时间尺度相匹配。 为了在离散生成模型中实现这一点，我们提出了统一频率残差量化（UFRQ）方法：它通过从粗到细的残差优化过程将所有频率带编码到一个共享的码本中，取代了碎片化的多码本流程，并将令牌序列长度缩短至同类设计的三分之一。 随后，一个具备尺度感知能力的掩码变换器（Chang et al. 2022）会同步生成所有频率带，从而实现稳定的单阶段生成。 此外，这种分解方式与生成器本身无关：将其移植到连续扩散流程中同样能提升该模型的性能，这表明性能增益源于表示方法本身，而非任何特定的量化方案。

paragraphs.en: The main contributions are summarized as follows:
paragraphs.zh: 主要贡献总结如下：

paragraphs.en: We identify single-scale temporal rigidity as a structural limitation in existing motion representations and characterize the resulting frequency entanglement.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将单尺度时间刚性视为现有运动表示中的一项结构性限制，并描述了由此产生的频率纠缠现象。

paragraphs.en: We propose Unified Frequency Residual Quantization, which encodes wavelet-disentangled bands into a single shared codebook while preserving temporal localization and exact reconstruction, replacing multi-stage residual pipelines with stable single-stage generation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了统一频率残差量化方法，该方法将经过小波解纠缠的频段编码到一个共享的单一码本中，同时保留时间局部性和精确重建能力，从而以稳定的单阶段生成方式取代了多阶段残差处理流程。

paragraphs.en: We show that the same representation improves generation quality under both discrete and continuous paradigms, confirming frequency disentanglement acts at the representation level and transfers across architectures.
paragraphs.zh: 我们证明，相同的表示在离散和连续两种范式下都能提升生成质量，这证实了频率解耦是在表示层面起作用的，并且能够跨架构迁移。

paragraphs.en: Learning an effective motion representation is a foundational challenge ( Liu et al. 2022 ; Siarohin et al. 2021 ; Zhu et al. 2023 ) . One major paradigm utilizes continuous latent spaces, typically via Variational Autoencoders (VAEs) ( Kingma and Welling 2013 ; Chen et al. 2023 ; Guo et al. 2022a ) , with recent methods operating directly on deterministic or causal latents ( Meng et al. 2025 ; Xiao et al. 2025 ; Yu et al. 2026 ) . However, the high precision of the continuous space can be detrimental, forcing the model to expend capacity encoding irrelevant, high-frequency noise and minor signal variations. This hinders generalization and complicates the subsequent generative task. An alternative paradigm learns a discrete representation using Vector Quantization (VQ-VAE) ( Van Den Oord et al. 2017 ) . By mapping poses to a finite codebook, VQ acts as a powerful regularizer, forcing the model to discard noise and learn a robust, semantic pose vocabulary ( Zhang et al. 2023a ; Jiang et al. 2023 ; Lu et al. 2025 ) . Given this robustness, our work builds upon the discrete quantization paradigm.
paragraphs.zh: 学习有效的运动表示是一项基础性的挑战（Liu 等人，2022；Siarohin 等人，2021；Zhu 等人，2023）。 一种主要范式利用连续潜在空间，通常通过变分自编码器（VAEs）实现（Kingma 和 Welling，2013；Chen 等人，2023；Guo 等人，2022a），而近期方法则直接在确定性或因果潜在变量上操作（Meng 等人，2025；Xiao 等人，2025；Yu 等人，2026）。 然而，连续空间的高精度可能适得其反，迫使模型消耗容量来编码无关紧要的高频噪声和微小的信号变化。 这会阻碍泛化能力，并使后续的生成任务更加复杂。 另一种范式则通过向量量化（VQ-VAE）学习离散表示（Van Den Oord 等人，2017）。 通过将姿态映射到有限的码本中，VQ 起到强大的正则化作用，迫使模型丢弃噪声并学习一种稳健的、具有语义的姿态度辞（Zhang 等人，2023a；Jiang 等人，2023；Lu 等人，2025）。 鉴于这种稳健性，我们的工作建立在离散量化范式之上。

paragraphs.en: Given a latent representation, a generative model is required. Diffusion Models ( Ho et al. 2020 ; Meng et al. 2025 ; Weng et al. 2026 ) achieve strong quality by iteratively denoising a sequence, but suffer from computational overhead and slow inference. Autoregressive models ( Vaswani et al. 2017 ; Lu et al. 2025 ; Yu et al. 2026 ; Bian et al. 2025 ) generate tokens sequentially; while strong at capturing temporal dependencies, they are also slow and can accumulate errors. Multimodal and whole-body variants further extend this paradigm ( Xu et al. 2026 ; Zhang et al. 2026 ) . To balance these trade-offs, non-autoregressive masked transformers ( Chang et al. 2022 ; Pinyoanuntapong et al. 2024 ; Zeng et al. 2025 ) , inspired by BERT ( Devlin et al. 2019 ) , have emerged as a powerful alternative. By predicting masked tokens in parallel, these models enable fast inference while maintaining high quality via iterative refinement. Therefore, we build our generator upon the bidirectional masked transformer framework.
paragraphs.zh: 给定一个潜在表示，需要一种生成模型。 扩散模型（Ho 等人，2020；Meng 等人，2025；Weng 等人，2026）通过迭代去除序列中的噪声来实现高质量生成，但存在计算开销大和推理速度慢的问题。 自回归模型（Vaswani 等人，2017；Lu 等人，2025；Yu 等人，2026；Bian 等人，2025）按顺序生成词元；尽管它们能有效捕捉时间依赖关系，但同样存在速度慢和可能累积错误的问题。 多模态和全身变体进一步扩展了这一范式（Xu 等人，2026；Zhang 等人，2026）。 为了平衡这些权衡，受 BERT（Devlin 等人，2019）启发的非自回归掩码变换器（Chang 等人，2022；Pinyoanuntapong 等人，2024；Zeng 等人，2025）已成为一种强大的替代方案。 通过并行预测被掩码的词元，这些模型能够在保持高质量的同时实现快速推理。 因此，我们将生成器构建在双向掩码变换器框架之上。

paragraphs.en: Given a text description 𝐜 \mathbf{c} , our goal is to generate a motion sequence 𝐗 = { 𝐱 t } t = 1 T \mathbf{X}=\{\mathbf{x}_{t}\}_{t=1}^{T} , where each 𝐱 t ∈ ℝ J \mathbf{x}_{t}\in\mathbb{R}^{J} denotes the pose at frame t t . Conventional representations discretize motion on a uniform temporal grid, forcing dynamics at different temporal scales to share identical support and entangling them before generation begins. To resolve this, we introduce FreqMo , separating motion across temporal scales through two components: a frequency-disentangled representation that decomposes latent motion into multi-scale bands via wavelet transform and encodes them through UFRQ; and a text-conditioned masked transformer that generates all frequency tokens jointly while modeling their cross-scale dependencies. The wavelet decomposition is the core of FreqMo, and because it is independent of the generator, it applies to both continuous and discrete latent spaces.
paragraphs.zh: 给定一个文本描述 𝐜 \mathbf{c}，我们的目标是生成一个运动序列 𝐗 = { 𝐱 t } t = 1 T \mathbf{X}=\{\mathbf{x}_{t}\}_{t=1}^{T}，其中每个 𝐱 t ∈ ℝ J \mathbf{x}_{t}\in\mathbb{R}^{J} 表示第 t 帧的姿态。 传统的表示方法将运动离散化到均匀的时间网格上，迫使不同时间尺度上的动态共享相同的支撑结构，并在生成开始前就将它们相互纠缠。 为了解决这个问题，我们引入了 FreqMo，通过两个组件将不同时间尺度上的运动分离开来：一个频率解纠缠的表示方法，它通过小波变换将潜在运动分解为多尺度频段，并通过 UFRQ 对其进行编码；以及一个文本条件化的掩码变换器，它在建模各频率标记跨尺度依赖关系的同时，联合生成所有频率标记。 小波分解是 FreqMo 的核心，并且由于它与生成器无关，因此既适用于连续潜在空间，也适用于离散潜在空间。

paragraphs.en: Quantizing each band { 𝐀 L , 𝐃 l } \{\mathbf{A}_{L},\mathbf{D}_{l}\} independently would fragment the latent space across scales and let quantization errors at coarse levels irreversibly corrupt finer details. UFRQ avoids both by encoding bands from coarse to fine within a single shared codebook, progressively capturing reconstruction residuals. Starting from the coarsest band 𝐀 L \mathbf{A}_{L} (Algorithm 1 ), we iteratively quantize 𝐀 l \mathbf{A}_{l} , reconstruct a partial signal via IDWT (with high-frequency components zeroed), and compute the residual against the current signal. This residual is then decomposed to the next finer approximation 𝐀 l − 1 \mathbf{A}_{l-1} and quantized in the same way. All frequency bands share a single codebook 𝒞 \mathcal{C} , as wavelet decomposition naturally aligns coefficient magnitudes across levels. During decoding (Algorithm 2 ), quantized approximations are reconstructed in reverse order and accumulated, with the final residual added to recover the full signal. This coarse-to-fine encoding order ensures low-frequency structure is captured with high fidelity first, while quantization errors are relegated to less critical high-frequency bands through progressive residual refinement.
paragraphs.zh: 对每个频段 { 𝐀 L , 𝐃 l } \{\mathbf{A}_{L},\mathbf{D}_{l}\} 进行独立量化，会将潜在空间在不同尺度上碎片化，并导致粗粒度层级的量化误差不可逆地破坏更精细的细节。 UFRQ 通过在一个共享的单一码本中从粗到细编码各频段，逐步捕捉重建残差，从而避免了上述两种问题。 从最粗的频段 𝐀 L \mathbf{A}_{L}（算法 1）开始，我们迭代量化 𝐀 l \mathbf{A}_{l}，通过 IDWT 重建部分信号（高频分量置零），并计算与当前信号的残差。 随后，该残差被分解到下一个更精细的近似值 𝐀 l − 1 \mathbf{A}_{l-1}，并以相同方式量化。 所有频率频段共享一个单一码本 𝒞 \mathcal{C}，因为小波分解天然地使不同层级的系数幅度保持一致。 在解码过程中（算法 2），量化的近似值按逆序重建并累加，最后将最终残差加入以恢复完整信号。 这种从粗到细的编码顺序确保了低频结构首先被高精度捕捉，而量化误差则通过渐进式残差优化被限制在相对不关键的高频频段中。

paragraphs.en: Evaluation metrics. paragraphs.en: Implementation details. The encoder and decoder use residual blocks with downsampling factor 4. Wavelet decomposition uses L = 5 L=5 levels with db2 wavelets, and the shared codebook holds K = 512 K=512 codes of dimension d = 512 d=512 . The tokenizer is trained for 200k iterations (batch size 512, learning rate 2 × 10 − 4 2\times 10^{-4} , commitment weight β = 0.25 \beta=0.25 ); the masked transformer has 8 layers, 6 heads, and hidden dimension 384, with masking ratio ρ = 0.3 \rho=0.3 . The generator is trained for 100k iterations (batch size 64) with the tokenizer frozen, and inference uses M = 12 M=12 refinement steps. All models are implemented in PyTorch on a single NVIDIA 4090 GPU.

paragraphs.en: Quantitative results. Table 1 compares FreqMo against state-of-the-art methods. FreqMo achieves the best FID on HumanML3D (0.040) and a competitive FID on KIT-ML (0.174). While ReMoDiffuse attains a lower FID (0.155) through retrieval augmentation, FreqMo operates without any external retrieval mechanism, making the comparison complementary rather than direct. For consistency, we compare only methods reporting averaged results with confidence intervals; single-run methods without variance (e.g., Light-T2M ( Zeng et al. 2025 ) ) are discussed in the appendix. Notably, evaluating the wavelet representation under a continuous paradigm (FreqMo-Diff), which replaces UFRQ with a VAE and diffusion decoder, consistently outperforms its frame-wise counterpart MLD ( Chen et al. 2023 ) , confirming the gains stem from the frequency-disentangled representation rather than the quantization scheme.
paragraphs.zh: 定量结果。 表 1 比较了 FreqMo 与当前最先进的多种方法。 FreqMo 在 HumanML3D 数据集上取得了最佳的 FID（0.040），并在 KIT-ML 数据集上获得了具有竞争力的 FID（0.174）。 尽管 ReMoDiffuse 通过检索增强实现了更低的 FID（0.155），但 FreqMo 无需任何外部检索机制即可运行，因此二者的比较是互补性的，而非直接对比。 为保持一致性，我们仅比较了报告了平均结果及置信区间的各种方法；对于没有方差信息的单次运行方法（例如 Light-T2M（Zeng et al. 2025）），我们将在附录中讨论。 值得注意的是，在连续范式下对小波表示进行评估的方法（FreqMo-Diff），该方法用 VAE 和扩散解码器取代了 UFRQ，其表现始终优于基于帧的对应方法 MLD（Chen et al. 2023），这证实了性能提升源于频率解耦的表示方式，而非量化方案。

paragraphs.en: Reconstruction performance. To isolate the representation from the generation model, Table 2 evaluates reconstruction fidelity and high-frequency preservation across quantization methods. Compared to RQ-VAE 6 \text{RQ-VAE}_{6} , the strongest error-based baseline, FreqMo reduces Acceleration Error by 10.8% (2.15 vs. 2.41) and Jerk Error by 9.2% (532 vs. 586) while using one-third of the tokens (106 vs. 294) and a single shared codebook. This supports our central claim: disentangling frequencies at the representation level preserves the rapid transient dynamics that uniform encodings smooth out.

paragraphs.en: Ablation study. Table 4 validates each design choice. Group 1 isolates tokenizer components: removing either wavelet decomposition (c) or residual quantization (d) substantially degrades FID, while their combination yields the best result, confirming that frequency disentanglement and progressive refinement are synergistic. Group 2 evaluates the generator: removing Scale-Aware Attention increases FID from 0.040 to 0.053, and switching to autoregressive decoding degrades it to 0.088, confirming both are essential. Group 3 shows that performance improves with decomposition depth up to L = 5 L{=}5 , beyond which it marginally degrades. Group 4 examines wavelet basis sensitivity: performance stays stable across bases, indicating the gains stem from the multi-scale paradigm rather than any specific basis.
paragraphs.zh: 消融研究。 表 4 验证了每一项设计选择。 第 1 组隔离了分词器组件：移除小波分解（c）或残差量化（d）中的任一项都会显著降低 FID，而两者结合则能产生最佳结果，证实频率解耦与渐进式优化具有协同效应。 第 2 组评估了生成器：移除“尺度感知注意力”会使 FID 从 0.040 升至 0.053，而改用自回归解码则会将其降至 0.088，证实两者均至关重要。 第 3 组表明，随着分解深度增加，性能会持续提升至 L = 5 L{=}5，超过该深度后则略有下降。 第 4 组检验了小波基底的敏感性：性能在不同基底间保持稳定，说明性能提升源于多尺度范式，而非任何特定的基底。

paragraphs.en: Frequency structure: FreqMo vs. RQ-VAE. As the dominant multi-stage quantization baseline and the closest counterpart to UFRQ in token budget, RQ-VAE offers the natural comparison for internal latent organization. Figure 7 shows RQ-VAE exhibits entangled residuals with aliased spectra, each stage encoding an unstructured frequency mixture rather than isolating specific components. FreqMo instead produces cleanly separated bands, each capturing dynamics at a distinct temporal scale. This indicates UFRQ achieves genuine frequency disentanglement, not generic error reduction.
paragraphs.zh: 频率结构：FreqMo 与 RQ-VAE。 作为主导的多阶段量化基线，以及在令牌预算方面最接近 UFRQ 的对应方案，RQ-VAE 为内部潜在结构的组织提供了自然的对比基准。 图 7 显示，RQ-VAE 呈现出纠缠的残差和混叠频谱，每个阶段都编码了无结构的频率混合，而非隔离特定成分。 相比之下，FreqMo 生成了清晰分离的频段，每个频段都能捕捉到不同时间尺度上的动态变化。 这表明 UFRQ 实现了真正的频率解纠缠，而不仅仅是泛化的误差降低。

sents.zh: 频率结构：FreqMo 与 RQ-VAE。

sents.en: As the dominant multi-stage quantization baseline and the closest counterpart to UFRQ in token budget, RQ-VAE offers the natural comparison for internal latent organization.
sents.zh: 作为主导的多阶段量化基线，以及在令牌预算方面最接近 UFRQ 的对应方案，RQ-VAE 为内部潜在结构的组织提供了自然的对比基准。

sents.en: Figure 7 shows RQ-VAE exhibits entangled residuals with aliased spectra, each stage encoding an unstructured frequency mixture rather than isolating specific components.
sents.zh: 图 7 显示，RQ-VAE 呈现出纠缠的残差和混叠频谱，每个阶段都编码了无结构的频率混合，而非隔离特定成分。

sents.en: FreqMo instead produces cleanly separated bands, each capturing dynamics at a distinct temporal scale.
sents.zh: 相比之下，FreqMo 生成了清晰分离的频段，每个频段都能捕捉到不同时间尺度上的动态变化。

sents.en: This indicates UFRQ achieves genuine frequency disentanglement, not generic error reduction.
sents.zh: 这表明 UFRQ 实现了真正的频率解纠缠，而不仅仅是泛化的误差降低。

paragraphs.en: Quality-efficiency trade-off. Figure 8 plots generation quality (FID) against inference speed (AIT, average inference time) on a log scale. FreqMo sits in the optimal bottom-left quadrant, being both faster and more accurate.
paragraphs.zh: 质量与效率的权衡。 图 8 以对数坐标展示了生成质量（FID）与推理速度（AIT，平均推理时间）之间的关系。 FreqMo 位于最优的左下角象限，兼具更快的速度和更高的准确性。

paragraphs.en: This work introduces FreqMo, which addresses an overlooked limitation in motion generation: frequency entanglement from uniform temporal tokenization. Decomposing motion into hierarchical frequency bands and encoding them in a unified codebook via coarse-to-fine residual quantization, FreqMo achieves SOTA fidelity with faithful high-frequency preservation. Its consistent gains across discrete and continuous paradigms confirm the improvement stems from the multi-scale representation, pointing to frequency-disentangled modeling as a direction beyond human motion.
paragraphs.zh: 这项工作介绍了 FreqMo，它解决了运动生成中一个被忽视的局限性：均匀时间分词导致的频率纠缠。 通过将运动分解为分层频率带，并通过从粗到细的残差量化将其编码到统一的码本中，FreqMo 实现了当前最优的保真度，同时忠实地保留了高频成分。 它在离散和连续范式中的持续优势证实了这种改进源于多尺度表示，表明频率解纠缠的建模是超越人类运动研究的一个方向。
